notes.title: Update v0.31 – New UI Features & Improvements
notes.content:

New[/h3][list][*][p][b]Trade UI redesigned[/b]
Cleaner and easier to use.
Added [b]“Sell All”[/b] and [b]“Buy All”[/b] buttons for faster trading.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot UI upgrade[/b]
You can now [b]loot everything with a single button[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reverse flight adjusted[/b]
For added realism, reverse speed is now limited to [b]30% of normal speed[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Updated[/h3][list][*][p][b]Code improvements[/b] to prevent UI-related crashes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved planet spawner[/b] for more variety in sectors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot UI now closes automatically[/b] when no items remain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mining UI now closes automatically[/b] when no resources remain.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fix[/h3][list][*][p][b]Tutorial bug fixed[/b]: If you cancel the tutorial, it will no longer start automatically.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v0.29 — Waypoints & Sector Map Refresh
notes.content: [p][b]TL;DR:[/b] Set single & chained waypoints, visible sector borders on map & minimap, refreshed sector map, better danger-level distribution at higher sensor ranges, more scannable objects — plus bug fixes.[/p][h2]New[/h2][list][*][p][b]Waypoints on the Sector Map[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Create waypoint:[/b] [b]Right Mouse Button (RMB)[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Create multiple waypoints quickly:[/b] [b]Hold Shift + RMB[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-navigation:[/b] Your ship automatically heads to the next waypoint as soon as one is placed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Visible sector borders[/b] on [b]Sector Map[/b] and [b]Minimap[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h2]Updated[/h2][list][*][p][b]Icons added[/b] to the [b]Home Sector[/b] menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sector Map redesigned[/b] for better clarity and planning.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved danger-level distribution[/b] for discovered sectors:[/p][list][*][p]With [b]Sensor Range 5[/b] you’ll see [b]more Danger Level 4[/b] sectors.[/p][/*][*][p]With [b]Sensor Range 6[/b] you’ll see [b]mostly Danger Level 5[/b] sectors.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]More objects can be scanned[/b] within a sector.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed [b]translation display issues[/b] in the [b]Extraction UI[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]UI rendering[/b] for [b]selected containers[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Pro tip: Fast route planning with waypoints[/h2][olist][*][p]Open the [b]Sector Map[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]RMB[/b] on any position to place a waypoint.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold Shift + RMB[/b] repeatedly to [b]chain a route[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]ship auto-follows[/b] the newest waypoint and works through the chain.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thanks for all the feedback—keep it coming, and enjoy exploring! 🚀[/p]

tags.feature: Create waypoint: Right Mouse Button (RMB).
Create multiple waypoints quickly: Hold Shift + RMB.
Auto-navigation: Your ship automatically heads to the next waypoint as soon as one is placed.
Visible sector borders on Sector Map and Minimap.
Icons added to the Home Sector menu.
Sector Map redesigned for better clarity and planning.
Improved danger-level distribution for discovered sectors:
With Sensor Range 5 you’ll see more Danger Level 4 sectors.
With Sensor Range 6 you’ll see mostly Danger Level 5 sectors.
More objects can be scanned within a sector.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.28.4 – Research Tooltip Costs Fixed
notes.content:
[h2]Hotfix: Research costs in tooltips are now accurate[/h2][p]
[b]TL;DR:[/b] A display bug caused the research tooltips to show ship/system costs while the Buy button correctly checked the [i]ResearchItem[/i] costs (credits + resources). This made entries like [i]Pulse laser[/i] or [i]Argo Freighter A[/i] look “green” but not actually purchasable. Fixed now.

[/p][p][b]What changed[/b][/p][list][*][p] Minor cleanup in tooltip text blocks.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Chinese New Year Update: New Features, More Control, Greater Challenges
notes.content:
I have prepared a major update for Astrosphere, set to release in time for the Chinese New Year. This update expands the game with exciting new features, additional ships, and important improvements that make the gameplay even more immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778342/ca051f8e19453134740ad0a3ac9f6f631738832c.png[/img]

The new manual weapon mode in particular provides more control in battles and opens up new tactical possibilities.

Additionally, there are numerous optimizations to enhance the gaming experience, as well as some bug fixes that address existing issues.
I'm excited to share this update with you and look forward to your feedback!

[h2]New Features[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Manual Weapon Mode:[/b] You can now switch between automatic and manual firing, giving you more control and adding more dynamism to battles.  
[*][b]Fire Mode Toggle:[/b] Press [b]F[/b] to switch between automatic and manual firing.  
[*][b]Alert State Control:[/b] The alert state can now be controlled with the [b]R[/b] key.  
[*][b]Destruction of Civilian Ships:[/b] With manual firing enabled, you can now attack civilian ships.  
[*][b]Wiki Button:[/b] A new button in the options menu now provides direct access to the game wiki.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]New Systems and Ships[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Medium Cargo Expansion:[/b] A new ship system that increases your cargo capacity.  
[*][b]Light Torpedo MK2:[/b] An upgraded weapon system dealing increased damage.  
[*][b]New Ship – Tianlong:[/b] A versatile combat ship with exceptional agility and a powerful reactor core. Inspired by the legend of the celestial dragon, it combines impressive speed with strong defensive systems. Ideal for commanders who favor quick maneuvers and heavy firepower.  
[*][b]New Ship – Fenghuang:[/b] Named after the mythical phoenix, this ship balances offense and defense. It features adaptive shield technology that regenerates after taking damage, along with a sophisticated weapon platform for medium to long-range combat. Perfect for strategic tacticians.  
[*][b]New Ship – Zhenwu:[/b] A heavily armored patrol ship equipped with energy absorption technology. With its durable structure and advanced sensor array, it excels in long-duration deep-space missions. Choosing the Zhenwu means relying on endurance, resilience, and precision counterattacks.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]Update[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]User interface improvements for a better player experience.  
[*]Adjusted dialogue triggers for planets.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Fixed an issue in the options menu where the button intended to return to the main menu would instead exit the game.  
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented players from recovering resources when replacing ship systems.  
[*]Fixed an issue in the research system where already researched items were not displayed as completed.  
[/list]

[b]Alert State Control:[/b] The alert state can now be controlled with the [b]R[/b] key.

notes.title: Update v0.15
notes.content:
I'm excited to introduce the latest update! This update brings several key changes that will make your gameplay even more engaging. You'll need to manage your resources more carefully and take a more strategic approach. Here are the details:

[list]
